title: WR Knox found negligent in crash, to pay $2.88M

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: WR Knox found negligent in crash, to pay $2.88M
sources.description: A Texas court issued a default judgment of more than $2.8 million against Theodore Knox, the co-defendant in one of the civil lawsuits against Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice stemming from a 2024 street racing crash in Dallas.
